notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
All,

There have been recent changes to the core engine behind Evocadi, Unreal Engine, that will enable a more direct route to fulfilling scope requirements of the project.

Due to this, we are extending the release time-line for Evocadi to allow more time for implementation and testing.

There will be more information released regarding the phases of release, and the roll-out of supporting systems.

That is all for now. 

- Evocadi
